content: Do not drain this product unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of the product when it has expired or is no longer needed. The information provided here was last updated in September 2024. Important Usage Information: This document serves as a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your use. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice and should not replace consultation with your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Keep a detailed list of all products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. Be aware that this medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as specific diabetic urine tests, potentially leading to false results. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. For less urgent cases, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Prescription Use: This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition. Do not use it for other conditions unless directed by your doctor. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage Instructions: Store this medication in the refrigerator and do not freeze it. Discard any unused portion after 14 days. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly dispose of the product when it is expired or no longer needed. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most up-to-date information.
